title: Failure of owner to perform work.
officialText:
If no action in accordance with the modified precept is undertaken by
the owner or applicant for modification within the time period provided in the modification following the granting of such
application, the commissioner may direct the department of housing preservation and development or the department of
citywide administrative services or other authorized agency to execute the original precept, provided however that prior to
such execution, notice shall be provided by regular mail to the owner of the unsafe building, structure or premises and
applicant for the modification if other than the owner, at his or her last known address. The owner shall continue to have the
right to request the commissioner to modify the requirements of the precept prior to the execution thereof.
